posts.text: The tornados that hit Stewartville & Marion township were dangerously strong today. Was in Rochester for Salvation Army dinner and also met with and thanked volunteers at the Red Cross emergency center shelter at Autumn Ridge church. So many homes damaged but thankfully no one died or seriously injured and all were taken in by friends, family and neighbors. Incredible work by Olmsted County first responders and the community. ❤️

In Waseca, I heard plans for a new, much-needed Justice Center that will break ground this fall. The county’s current courthouse is one of the oldest in the state, and I look forward to working with them on their new building.

Big news: "4000 Days" will premiere at the Tribeca Film Festival, inspired by our bipartisan anti-hazing bill — now law — and the parents and advocates who came together to fight to end hazing and to keep students safe.

The administration is threatening a major escalation of the war it unilaterally started with Iran — and now wants $200 billion more. That money could and should be used to lower health care costs, build more housing, and make things more affordable for Americans.

Video

Just spoke on the Senate floor to oppose this unprecedented use of a procedural mechanism that would have major consequences for the Boundary Waters and public lands across the country. I know some of my Republican colleagues oppose this, and they need to stand up and do the right thing.

Budgets are about values. Trump wants $200 billion for his unilateral war in Iran, yet he let health care premiums double for Americans. That same amount could extend ACA tax credits for 7 years. Or cover dental/hearing/vision for EVERY senior on Medicare — for 3 years!

Video

Breaking news: New York jury finds Ticketmaster/Live Nation to be an anticompetitive monopoly. 

FINALLY.  A jury says the truth about what nearly everyone in Washington keeps denying.

Now we need remedies that help fans & lower prices, unlike DOJ meaningless “settlement.”

The Live Nation-Ticketmaster settlement doesn’t deliver real competition and won’t do anything to lower prices for fans.

There are serious concerns here and the court needs to investigate.

Thank you to the thousands of supporters from all 87 Minnesota counties who launched our campaign in just two months.

My focus? A state government that can carry its weight and match the drive of the people of our state. That means standing up for what’s right and urgently fixing what is wrong.
